run_GTestXMLOutputUnitTest: run the gtest XML output unit test to verify Google Test XML report generation
test_non_empty_xml_output: test that a gtest binary produces the expected non-empty XML output with test results
test_empty_xml_output: test that a gtest binary with no tests produces an empty XML output document
test_timestamp_value: test that the timestamp attribute in the gtest XML output is a valid datetime
test_filtered_test_xml_output: test that gtest XML output only includes tests matching a filter pattern
